name: Slant
rules: Draw a diagonal in every cell. A number says how many diagonals touch that corner; corners with no number are free. The diagonals must never join up into a loop.
technique.1: This number already has all the lines it needs, so every other cell around it must slant away from it.
technique.2: This number still needs exactly as many lines as it has empty cells around it, so all of those cells must slant towards it.
technique.3: The two corners this line would join are already linked by a chain of lines, so joining them would close a loop, and the cell must slant the other way.
technique.4: This line would join two groups of lines that never reach the edge of the grid and have no other way out, sealing them into a loop, so the cell must slant the other way.
technique.5: The numbers between this cell and the highlighted filled cell can only be met if the two slant the same way, so copy the filled cell.
technique.6: Two neighbouring empty cells around this number must slant the same way, so between them they give it exactly one line, and that settles the other cells around it.
demo.1: Every cell gets one diagonal. It can lean either way, but no cell is left empty.
demo.2: A number counts the diagonals that touch that corner. Two touch this 2, so it is done.
demo.3: The same diagonal ends on a corner with no number. Those corners count nothing, so they never limit you.
demo.4: This corner needs four, so all four cells around it have to point at it. There is only one way to do that.
demo.5: These four have joined up into a closed ring. Rings are not allowed, so one of them must lean the other way.
demo.6: Every cell filled, every number matched, and no ring anywhere.
hint.satisfied.some: The outlined {clue} already has all the lines it needs, so every ? cell around it must slant away from it.
hint.satisfied.zero: The outlined {clue} can't touch any lines, so every ? cell around it must slant away from it.
hint.forced.all: The outlined {clue} needs a line from every cell around it, so every ? cell must slant towards it.
hint.forced.one: The outlined {clue} still needs 1 line, and only one cell around it is empty, so the ? cell must slant towards it.
hint.forced.many: The outlined {clue} still needs {needed} lines, and only {needed} cells around it are empty, so every ? cell must slant towards it.
hint.paired.away: The two outlined cells must slant the same way, so together they give the outlined {clue} exactly one line. That is all it still needs, so every ? cell around it must slant away from it.
hint.paired.towards: The two outlined cells must slant the same way, so together they give the outlined {clue} exactly one line. It still needs {needed} more after that, so every ? cell around it must slant towards it.
hint.loop.backslash: The outlined cell's top-left and bottom-right corners are already joined by a chain of lines, so a line between them would close a loop. The cell must slant from bottom-left to top-right.
hint.loop.slash: The outlined cell's bottom-left and top-right corners are already joined by a chain of lines, so a line between them would close a loop. The cell must slant from top-left to bottom-right.
hint.deadEnd.backslash: The outlined corners belong to two groups of lines, one at the outlined cell's top-left corner and one at its bottom-right. Neither reaches the edge, and each can grow by at most one more line. Joined, they would make a group that can never reach the edge, which only happens inside a loop. So the cell must slant from bottom-left to top-right.
hint.deadEnd.slash: The outlined corners belong to two groups of lines, one at the outlined cell's bottom-left corner and one at its top-right. Neither reaches the edge, and each can grow by at most one more line. Joined, they would make a group that can never reach the edge, which only happens inside a loop. So the cell must slant from top-left to bottom-right.
hint.equivalent: The numbers between the outlined cell and the filled cell in row {row}, column {column} can only be met if the two slant the same way, so the outlined cell must copy it.
